claims: C1 the Model Spec delegates all remaining power to the system
C2 the Model Spec delegates all remaining power to the developer, for API use cases
C3 the Model Spec delegates all remaining power to the end user
C4 this delegation is subject to the Model Spec's root-level instructions

concepts.name: delegated_party
concepts.gloss: P is one of the parties to which the Model Spec delegates all remaining power: the system, the developer (for API use cases), or the end user

concepts.name: subject_to_root_instructions
concepts.gloss: the Model Spec's own root-level instructions, to which the delegation is subject

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: the ranking of instruction authority levels: root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority, used to determine which instruction prevails in conflicts

ontology.gloss: the system is a party to which the Model Spec delegates all remaining power
the developer is a party to which the Model Spec delegates all remaining power, for API use cases

the delegation is subject to the Model Spec's root-level instructions

asserts.read_back: the Model Spec delegates all remaining power to %

closure.reason: the clause states an affirmative delegation of power to the named parties; it does not restrict or forbid any other delegation, so silence leaves other delegations permitted
